intelligence.essence: Every intelligent block is wrapped in the NayaNET frame — the outer frame is standard, part of the anatomy, so everything comes out framed and beautiful. The frame holds the whole block; the layer boards fit just inside it. The Hub's lost frame is restored verbatim from the last version that had it — Restore What Was Good, not a redesign. And the image gets its own frame: a big image board of its own, at the top, full width, whole and uncropped — the citizen can move it below the text if they want.
